key_insight: Surrogate-guided reinforcement learning enriched virtual perovskite recipe shortlists near high-performing experimental neighbors, without establishing fabricated-device performance.
engineering_relevance: The framework could help prioritize perovskite compositions, device layers, and processing recipes before costly fabrication.
method: Generate device recipes using reinforcement-learning policies guided by a frozen TabPFN surrogate.
Assess neighborhood support against 890 experimentally measured devices.
Compare three learned policies with six baselines using 3,000 surrogate evaluations per run.
evidence_signal: At top-100 selection, PPO and recurrent PPO achieved neighborhood-supported hit rates of 23% and 24%, versus 2.9% for Pure Random and 10% for the strongest baselines on this metric.
watch_item: Experimental performance, seed robustness, and matched-budget advantage remain unproven; composition-family support also drops sharply at stricter similarity thresholds.
paper_title: Enrichment-Oriented Virtual Screening of Perovskite Solar Cells through Reinforcement Learning
